characterGuideline.decisionSummary: 入力画像0件の独自生成ファンアートとして使用し、非公式であることとcreditを表示する。第三者配布素材や公式画像の再利用はない。

credit: 太宰治ずんだもん：OpenAI built-in image_genによる独自生成（入力・参照画像なし）

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: square author card illustration for a Japanese literature web app
Primary request: Create an entirely original chibi illustration of a green bean-themed fictional mascot reimagined as a witty, introspective early-20th-century Japanese novelist, evoking a literary atmosphere associated with Osamu Dazai without copying any real photograph, identifiable face, or existing character artwork.
Scene/backdrop: warm aged washi-paper texture with a loose circular charcoal ink-wash halo; sparse plum-blossom petals and a few abstract manuscript-paper motifs, with no readable writing.
Subject: one fictional mascot character only; leaf-green hair with two rounded bean-pod buns; large amber eyes; thoughtful but gently mischievous expression; modest charcoal-gray Japanese-Western literary coat over a cream shirt, muted wine-red scarf, holding a closed plain notebook and a fountain pen.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn anime chibi illustration, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture, clean dark outlines, visually compatible with a literary character card.
Composition/framing: centered full-body or knees-up portrait, generous padding, square composition, hands clearly visible and anatomically natural.
Lighting/mood: soft warm diffuse light, introspective, elegant, slightly wistful, approachable.
Color palette: parchment beige, leaf green, charcoal gray, cream, muted wine red, soft black ink.
Constraints: entirely original generated image; zero input or reference images; no depiction or tracing of Osamu Dazai or any real person; no copied pose or costume; no copyrighted third-party character costume or logo; no readable text; no signature; no watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, exact human likeness, bandages, cigarette, alcohol, weapons, military insignia, recognizable brand marks, extra people, distorted hands, extra fingers, cropped head, neon background.

providerTerms.decisionSummary: built-in image_genによる入力画像なし生成物の利用に関するprovider termsを選定時確認した。

generation.recipe: OpenAI built-in image_genへ上記promptを入力し、入力・参照画像0件で1枚生成。生成PNGを画像編集・合成・inpainting・文字追加・第三者素材追加なしでF003 tracked public-files正本へbyte-for-byteコピーした。
